# Aeternitas Tower

> Franck Muller Aeternitas is a 450-metre, 106-storey residential tower under construction in Dubai Marina, billed as the world's tallest residential clock tower and carrying a branded clock face near its crown. It will hold about 649 apartments and duplexes above six basement parking levels. Amenities include swimming pools, a cinema, a cigar room and a business centre, behind roughly 60,000 square metres of bespoke unitised façade.

## Project Overview

- Category: Residential / Commercial
- Location: Dubai Marina, UAE
- Status: On-Going
- Year: 2027

## MENASCO Scope

Franck Muller Aeternitas is a 106-storey, 450-metre residential tower in Dubai Marina, developed by London Gate in partnership with Swiss watchmaker Franck Muller and marketed as the world's tallest residential clock tower. The tower will house around 649 apartments, duplexes and sky villas. MENASCO is delivering the MEP works for this prominent addition to the Dubai Marina skyline.
